notes.title: Discover Dark Fracture, a new kind of psychological horror adventure
notes.content:
Feardemic is proud to announce the next generation of terror: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1268790/Dark_Fracture/][b]Dark Fracture[/b][/url], a psychological first-person horror adventure game in which jump scares are the least concerning occurrences that the players will be facing.

The game is developed by the indie team Twisted II Studio and will be released in 2022 on PC, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch.

[h2]About the game
[/h2]
Set in the late 90s in a forested area of the Northeastern USA, Dark Fracture brings you into the eerie environment of a body farm – a decomposition research facility. You enter the world as Edward, a lonely individual tormented by a tragic past, whose only solace is in the medicine that helps him to get through the day. Edward is barely able to cope with his issues, which are only intensified by the solitude of his workplace. He puts on a brave front and dutifully wakes up for work every day. His routine serves as his only anchor, but deep inside, trouble is simmering...

If you want to get a taste of what awaits you in Dark Fracture, you can already try Dark Fracture: Prologue, the free introductory chapter of the game 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1389160/Dark_Fracture_Prologue/

notes.title: One Shell Straight to Hell release date reveal!
notes.content:
Fancy some exorcism? Then rejoice in knowing that [i][b]One Shell Straight To Hell[/b][/i] is coming to Steam on February 9, 2021! 

That’s right, Padre Alexander is back, heavily armed to fight off hordes of demons while doing his best to help the Halliwell family. Join the fight in [i][b]One Shell Straight To Hell[/b][/i], the isometric, dungeon-crawling roguelike shooter. 

[i][b]One Shell Straight To Hell[/b][/i] will descend you into ever-changing dungeons that overflow with demonic enemies and put your insane skills and over the top weapons to the test against the satanic hordes. To survive you must shout orders to your allies, lay your traps, and raise your gun to lay waste to your enemies. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1330370/One_Shell_Straight_to_Hell/

[b] Key Features: [/b]
[list]
[*]Perplexing monsters- Ranging from the possessed kitchen drawer to drunken long-dead pirate captains and... I almost forgot, demons... a lot of demons.
[*]Regular weapons using a variety of ammunition, holy weapons drawing on your faith, and unholy weapons craving for your blood.
[*]Skill tree that makes you stronger and adds to the strategy.
[*]Base building... at least kind of. You will be able to build small factories to prepare...
[*]Traps for your enemies.
[*]Global enchantments
[*]Power-ups
[*]Randomly generated ‘dungeon’ maps
[*]And some more crazy absurd stuff!
[/list]

Take a look at the newest trailer of [i][b]One Shell Straight To Hell[/b][/i]:  
[previewyoutube=PZkPm87qP6o;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: DARQ: Complete Edition is HERE!
notes.content:
Our friendly dev team Unfold Games has just released their award-winning game [b][i]DARQ[/i][/b] with a little extra on top. Apart from the original game, [b][i]DARQ: Complete Edition[/i][/b] contains two DLCs, including The Crypt, which is available to play today for the first time. 

If you already own the original DARQ, you can download both DLCs, [i][b]The Tower[/b][/i] and [b][i]The Crypt[/i][/b], for free.

While we know this news is not directly related to 2084 we wanted to share it with you since we’re pretty sure that if you like horror games, you’ll enjoy DARQ too!

Curious what awaits you in [b][i]DARQ[/i][/b]? Let us give you a little sneak peek:

[b][i]DARQ[/i][/b] will take you on a journey through a boy's dreams that quickly turn into a loop of nightmares. Lloyd, the main character, is trying to wake up, but unfortunately, each attempt sinks him deeper into his lucid subconscious-driven dreams. Lloyd has to adapt to the new world, re-learn gravity, and strain his mind and all of his senses in order to solve puzzles and sneak past the creatures guarding the shadowy corners of DARQ.

Sounds fascinating, doesn’t it?

[b]DARQ: Complete Edition is available on the following platforms:[/b]
[list]
[*] PC
[*] Xbox One
[*] PlayStation 4
[/list]

[i]Owners of the PlayStation 4 and Xbox One versions will get a free upgrade to the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S version when it will release in 2021. DARQ: Complete Edition will also be released on Nintendo Switch early next year.[/i]


[u][b]Find out more and grab free digital gifts from DARQ here[/b][/u]:
[url=]https://www.feardemic-games.com/darq[/url]

Join Lloyd and help him wake up.

notes.title: The Raid - the future of 2084
notes.content:
Dear players of 2084,

My name is Giorgio, I’m a marketing and community guy that has recently joined the ranks of Feardemic, the publisher and developer of this game. Before we get to the subject of this post, allow me to say “thank you” on behalf of both Bloober Team and Feardemic for having supported 2084 by purchasing the Early Access version - it should have been said a long time ago.

As you might have heard, Feardemic has just revealed [url=https://www.feardemic-games.com/the-raid]The Raid[/url], a new fast-paced multiplayer shooter with PVP and PVE elements set in the same universe of Observer. For those of you who have seen the trailer (linked below), what we have shown probably looked very familiar, and therefore we owe you an explanation. I’ll also take the chance to finally address some of the many questions you have written in the forums over the past 21 months. But let’s start from what The Raid actually is.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Q1S7sTV_8QA

[h1]What is The Raid?[/h1]

As I just stated above, The Raid is a multiplayer shooter with PVP and PVE elements set in the same universe of Observer. 

In this grim cyberpunk world, The Raid is a VR tournament organized by the almighty Chiron Corporation, which attracts the distraught lower ends of the population looking for any opportunity to make some money. 
The players, as tournament participants, compete both between each other and against hordes of virtual enemies, ascending  upwards in a tower with the goal of reaching the top and  kill the boss to take home the prize

The players will fight using a range of unique and customizable weapons, as well as hacking abilities that will allow them to manipulate environments and opponents. 

Players will be able to use their tournament rewards to personalize their characters’ appearances.

[h1]How The Raid is different from 2084?[/h1]

As a matter of fact, the only things in common between 2084 and The Raid are that they are set in the Observer universe. The reason why they don’t even share the name is that The Raid goes in a completely new direction to that originally intended for 2084, and with a much wider scope - we don’t want to spoil everything, but we can guarantee you that 2084 is just a tiny fraction of what The Raid will be.

[h1]What happened to 2084? When it will leave Early Access?[/h1]

Let’s address the elephant in the room by finally breaking the silence on the status of the development: to no one’s surprise, the development of 2084 has been interrupted and won’t be resumed.
The reasons behind this decision are many, but essentially it’s because the concept and development plans of 2084 have been altered so much to make it easier to start building a new game from scratch rather than working around an existing one. Thus, the idea for The Raid was born.

[h1]Will I get rewarded for supporting 2084? And why is 2084 still in on sale?[/h1]

Actually, [b]YES[/b] - we intend to reward all of you who purchased 2084 by giving you almost-free access to The Raid once it’ll be released. Due to the much wider contents and higher development costs of The Raid as compared to 2084, we cannot afford to give you The Raid completely for free, but we promise that the purchase price for owners of 2084 will be merely symbolic.
This also brings us to why 2084 is still on sale - consider it as a way to support the development of The Raid by “preordering” it. Eventually, once The Raid will be released, 2084 will be removed from sale.

[h1]Will The Raid be an Early Access game?[/h1]

[b]NO [/b]- we intend to release The Raid as a finished, completely functional experience that will eventually get expanded through updates depending on its initial success.

[h1]Are you going to keep us updated this time?[/h1]
[b]YES[/b], we do intend to keep you updated about the development of The Raid before, during, and after the launch.
While there are no excuses for the complete wall of silence that surrounded 2084, we promise you that the development of The Raid will be transparent, the communication regular, and that we will keep all of you posted through the official Feardemic channels (you can find the links below) as well as here on the 2084 Steam community spaces.

[h1]So when The Raid is going to be released? And what’s the status of its development?[/h1]
At the moment, the release is set for early 2022. The Raid is in the very early development stage, therefore it might take some time before you’ll get to know more about it, but we guarantee you we won’t withhold any information about it.

That’s all - I once again thank you for your support and apologize for the silence - we look forward to bring you more news about The Raid.

[i]- Giorgio from Feardemic[/i]
